decisions.statement: A relation value is handed to the resolver unchanged, id or address.
A chip links and navigates by the id of the page the relation reaches.
A relation value reaching no page is drawn as the name its address ends in.
A value holding no slash is no address, and is drawn as the text that value is.
A page holding no title is drawn as the name reaching it rather than as Untitled.

definition: the page a relation value reaches, and the name and color it is drawn under
